markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (84%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Invasive · Careful review
Both classes are in the 90% conformal set; input quality is not flagged. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 84%, InSitu 16% | Clear lead, not decisive |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive | Two classes not separable |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.96 / OOD pct 1.0 | Not flagged; blur simulated |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Invasive | Mostly supportive [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score here; concept model leans away from invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Low score; concept model reads this toward invasive; caption inconsistent · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 5, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score, but failed spot check (0/20) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score; spot check only 3/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions lowers the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses and necrosis are Unreliable here.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated blur (severity 3) degrades the image; InSitu remains in the 90% set.
- Mitosis and necrosis scores favoring invasive failed spot checks, so that support may be spurious.

## Check on the slide
1. **4** · Confirm tumor at the medial margin (108 µm suggested). [F7]
2. **1, 11** · Separate duct-confined atypia from stromal invasion; InSitu is in the set.
3. **5, 8, 9** · Count mitoses by eye; the mitosis score failed its spot check.
